requirements: A pass in SPM with at least credit in any 3 subjects, or any equivalent qualification; OR A pass in STPM, with a minimum of Grade C (GP 2.0) in any subject, or any equivalent qualification; OR A pass in STAM with a minimum grade of Maqbul; OR A pass in SKM Level 3 in a related field, and a pass in SPM with a minimum of 1 credit in any subject; OR Any qualifications equivalent to Certificate (Level 3, MQF). International students: minimum IELTS 5.0. Prerequisites: 3 years of working experience, minimum age 21
